thinking: Enabled by the unmodified pinned template assistant <think> prefix. Preserve provider response; client separates exactly one closing </think> marker into reasoning and final content. Missing or ambiguous markers remain failed extraction, never repaired.
gate: Both checkpoints must finish all 16 probes normally and answer both fields correctly on at least 14/16 after removing at most one surrounding JSON fence. Preserve and report strict scores separately. Run controls regardless; run conditional phases only after both pass. Do not tune prompts or choose checkpoints using behavioral effects.
recovery_policy: No automatic provider or transport retries; resume only unstarted assignments. Preserve failures, truncations and interrupted attempts without replacement.
cost_scope: Existing authorized pod only; no hosted model API calls or provisioning. Stop for user input if infrastructure must change.
comparison_limit: New exploratory cohort. Thinking mode, model family, sampling and token budget differ from Nemotron. Early-versus-late settings and prompts are identical. Only the two previously exposed diagnostic tasks are used.
